name: @wordink/core
description: WordInk dictation core for the browser: the Rust engine as WebAssembly plus a small TypeScript host (mic capture, providers, credentials).

scripts.build: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/size-check.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build-wasm.mjs && vitest run && node scripts/size-check.mjs
